name: YouTube MCP Server
description: Provides distraction-free access to YouTube by allowing AI assistants to retrieve subscribed channels, latest videos, and transcripts without algorithmic recommendations. It enables searching within subscriptions and direct reading of video content through simple browser cookie authentication.
